ZipRIGHT Designs Private Limited ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. Personal Data

Name, email address, phone number, gender, and date of birth that you voluntarily give to us when registering.

Biometric & Body Data

Height, weight, and body photographs uploaded for the purpose of sizing. Note: We process these images to extract measurement points and generate a 3D avatar. We do not store raw images permanently unless explicitly consented to.

Device Data

IP address, device ID, operating system, and browser type for security and analytics.

  • To generate accurate size recommendations using our AI algorithms.

We retain your personal data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. Role: Senior Frontend Architect (React/Tailwind CSS).

Task: Refactor the existing UI to be System Adaptable (Auto Dark/Light Mode) while adopting the navigation layout of Myntra.

1. Theming Logic (System Adaptable):

Implement a Theme Context that detects the user's system preference (prefers-color-scheme).

Color Mapping:

Background: White (#FFFFFF) in Light Mode ↔ Black (#000000) in Dark Mode.

Primary Text: Dark Grey (#282C3F) in Light Mode ↔ White (#FFFFFF) in Dark Mode.

Cards/Containers: Light Grey (#F5F5F6) in Light Mode ↔ Dark Grey (#1A1A1A) in Dark Mode.

Accent Color: Keep the "Myntra Pink" (#FF3F6C) for both modes (for buttons, active tabs, and icons).

2. Top Navigation (Myntra Style):

Layout: Remove the current large oval category buttons. Replace them with a Sticky Horizontal Text Tab Bar.

Tabs: "All", "Men", "Women", "Kids".

Selection Style: The active tab should have a thick Pink (#FF3F6C) underline.

Light Mode: Active text is Black. Inactive is Grey.

Dark Mode: Active text is White. Inactive is Grey.

3. Bottom Navigation:

Layout: Fixed bottom bar with 3 items: Home, Shop, Profile.

Styling:

Light Mode: White background, light shadow.

Dark Mode: Black background, dark border-top.

4. The "Shop" Tab (Dual Interface):

When "Shop" is active, display a Segmented Control (Toggle) at the top of the screen.

Toggle Options: "Buyer Store" vs "Seller Hub".

Behavior:

Buyer Store: Shows the grid of product cards (adaptive background).

Seller Hub: Shows a dashboard view with "Upload Product" and "Analytics" placeholders.

5. Product Cards:

Refactor: Clean, edge-to-edge images with the brand name and price below.

Adaptive Background: The card background must turn white in Light Mode and #1A1A1A (Dark Grey) in Dark Mode so it pops against the main background.

**Defining the UI Goal**

I'm currently focused on defining the project goal as a system-adaptable UI refactor. My role as a Senior Frontend Architect shapes this initial analysis. This is to ensure a firm base for future changes.


**Refining the Implementation**

I'm now zeroing in on the practical steps. My current focus is implementing the system-adaptable theming, specifically detecting `prefers-color-scheme` and mapping the color palette. I'm also planning the Myntra-style top navigation's sticky tab bar, and the logic to switch between "Buyer Store" and "Seller Hub". I'm looking at the codebase and mapping out changes to the Tailwind config in `index.html` and theme detection in `App.tsx`.


**Mapping the Next Screen**

I'm now scoping out the work for core screens: `Marketplace.tsx` needs the sticky top navigation, the Buyer/Seller toggle, and a card refactor.
